groups.name: final_battle
groups.note: Caesar, House and Yes Man endings are mutually exclusive; first committed wins, host breaks races.

quests.note: Debug content; exclude from story gating.

Dead Money forces a solo-style companion/collar structure. Policy: whole party enters together (collars are per-player and detonate per-player); death of a collared player is a downed state until the party clears the next checkpoint.
Vault/ending scene is a party-warp with shared outcome; gold bars follow the quest-item rule (each player gets their own full set - owner decision, documented as a balance risk).
Party-warp onto the Zion arrival; companions follow owner.
Party-wide fast-travel flag; kills union; rewards to all.
Autosave suppressed; party-warp; locks for all.

Party-wide ending: Ending slideshow: set-in-chargen + all controls disabled + MoveTo slideshow marker. Run once on host; every player is locked and moved in the same txn, sees the same slides, and is released together at slideshow end.
AutoDoc customisation is per-player; HQ buddy ownership = the player who completes the quest, shared access afterwards.
As HQBuddy: per-player scene, shared outcome.
Teleporter is a party-warp (everyone in range); AutoDoc scene per-player (each player's own upgrade; stat results target that player); doors open on party-any.
Debug/demo content, not part of the shipped story: exclude from the story gate (mark "not required for any ending"). If ever reached, treat as host-only cheat.

Each player runs chargen/intro for themself (per-player SPECIAL/skills/appearance, never shared). World state (Doc Mitchell, Goodsprings) is shared; stage advance past the intro is a barrier: SetStage fires when ALL players have finished their own intro.

Per-player: race menu, SPECIAL test, skill tags, perk (these effects target the originating player, NOT Recipient=All - the one exception to "rewards to everyone"). Shared: Doc, quest stage, items handed out as quest items (duplicated).
Shared stage; any MoveTo is a party-warp; reward items to all.
Initiator drives; Legion hostility outcomes share reputation (shared). Companion-restricted lines use the recruiter's companions.
Companion owned by recruiter; the recruiter is the initiator for companion-quest dialogue. Companion perks apply to the owner only.
Initiator talks; entry for the whole party is granted by the result (EnableRef/unlock is world state, so everybody can enter).
Securitron-vault battle: party-warp to the start marker, free combat, host-decided outcome. Ending slideshow: set-in-chargen + all controls disabled + MoveTo slideshow marker. Run once on host;
Same battle policy as All or Nothing; securitron vault flag read from host. Ending slideshow: set-in-chargen + all controls disabled + MoveTo slideshow marker. Run once on host;

Duel is the initiator's; other players are spectators locked out of the duel arena (or inside, non-combat) until it resolves. Outcome shared. Ending slideshow: set-in-chargen + all controls disabled + MoveTo slideshow marker. Run once on host;
Free roam. Each player can trigger NPC dialogue; the first activator is initiator for that scene. Quest items (e.g. the Sunny/Primm hand-ins) duplicated to everyone; shared stage max-merge.

Elevators and Fort transfers are party-warps (the elevator teleports are MoveTo, not a cell transition: warp every player in the car/in range). Skill gate uses initiator; party-best optional. Quest items duplicated.

Story moment: party must be at Hoover Dam. All "Player.Get*" checks become party-aware: GetDistance = min over party, GetInCell HooverDam == 0 only when NO party member is inside (timer pauses while any are in).
As VMQ03a: tether at Hoover Dam, party-aware distance/cell checks, host-decided outcome.
Reputation changes are shared; rewards (caps/items) to each player; NCR gear checks (GetEquipped faction armor) evaluate for the initiator.
Failure is a party-wide shared state; inventory removal hits every player's quest item copy.

Tether party into the Suite: the Benny scene starts only when all players are in the cell (or are warped in). Initiator drives all dialogue and speech/skill checks (policy: initiator's skill, optional best-of-party assist). IsKiller Player = any party member.
Host-run; party tethered to Lucky 38 for the takeover moment. Rewards to all.
Shared faction rep; dialogue initiator-driven.
Initiator chooses; reward to all.
Mainframe and Moore teleports are party-warps; control locks apply to all; skill gates use best-of-party (cooperative engineering) - decide per gate in scenario, default initiator.
Only enters via host. Companion-ownership effects target the recruiter.
Companion flags are keyed to each companion's owner. Trap/freezer scene: party tether, single initiator for the dialogue, locks release on host effect.
Initiator-scoped checks; rep/karma shared; rewards to all.
Initiator-scoped checks; rewards to all.
Initiator drives dialogue; hand-in items removed from the handing player and duplicated rewards to all.
Rewards to all; stage max-merge.
Hand-in removes from the handing player only; rewards to all.
Party tether for the battle; kills credited to the party (union).
Shared rep/karma; items to all.
Elevator = party-warp to the same floor marker for all players in the car; companions follow their owner.
As Boone: owner-driven.

Host runs the controller; battle zone progress is a function of the PARTY (max zone reached). Players free-roam inside the dam but fast travel is disabled party-wide. Death of one player respawns at last zone checkpoint (no quest failure).
